zh: Open-AutoGLM 技能原生工具化：解除工作空间目录限制，全平台（移动端 App 与 Web 对话）直接调用原生手机控制与屏幕抓取工具。
平台会话执行调度增强：普通对话与移动端对话原生集成 Android 自动化工具循环，支持实时截屏与任务自动化。
完善智能体工具沙箱防护与异常处理，优化断开恢复与会话工具状态一致性。
en: Transform Open-AutoGLM into a native toolset: eliminate workspace folder requirements for seamless mobile App and web-based Android automation.
Upgrade conversational agent execution loop with native Android screen capture and autonomous mobile task orchestration across clients.
Harden agent tool access control and runtime crash recovery for consistent tool availability.
